extension.summary: Down brings up the player OSD instead of skipping ten minutes
extension.description:
Kodi gives Up and Down two different jobs depending on what is playing. On a programme opened from the guide they skip ten minutes, which on a TV remote are the two easiest buttons to press by accident. On live TV they are channel up and channel down.
This add-on gives them one meaning everywhere: Down brings up the player OSD, and neither key seeks.
The OSD itself is left exactly as it is. Once it is open, Up, Down, Left and Right move around inside it and Back puts it away, all as usual.
What this costs is channel zapping from Up and Down on live TV. One pair of keys cannot both zap and open the OSD. The channels are still there: the OSD has a channel button, and the channel list is unchanged.
The keymap is written into your profile and reloaded in place, so it applies without restarting Kodi. Turning the setting off removes it again.
